docs/how-clutch-works.md:825:The Claude normalizer is verified only for `claude`, so qwen's Claude-shaped stream is unverified. Codex `input_tokens` includes cached tokens, so `input_uncached` is `input_tokens` minus `cached_input_tokens`. Each normalizer has a golden fixture under `tests/fixtures/evidence/<provider>/`. `CliAdapter.parse` and `CallMeter` read normalized events from the adapter’s normalizer. Claude assistant lines with usage also yield an `assistant/usage` event. The last `result` or `usage` event with a non-null status closes the call; it carries the outcome, final text blob, optional USD cost and optional model. Claude’s preceding usage event carries its tokens. `Event` provides optional `usd` and `model` fields. No call record has a `normalized/` directory.
